# Draft:KingSammelot

Samuel Rapier (born January 26, 2006), known online as KingSammelot, is an American online streamer and YouTuber who is primarily known for creating Geometry Dash content. He is also known for initially creating Minecraft content as of Fortnite. Rapier had recipient to multiple creator awards of winning the best Geometry Dash streamer in GD Awards, and 2022's Hidden Gem Award from 2022 Streamer Awards.
Career
2014: Beginnings
Rapier started his YouTube channel in 2014 with the name "GarfieldSam7". He currently uploads FlipaClip also included with the video "The Reverse", which gained million views in late 2015.
2018-2019: Fortnite and Minecraft
Rapier was well known of Fortnite in June 19, 2018, while it was a short time montage of Battle Royale. He created 12-uploads of the internet game, included it was remarkable quality in a such time. In 2019, He independently uploads Minecraft content initially such a young age around that time and later inactively stopped.
2020-2021: Geometry Dash content
Rapier independently started to interest of the game Geometry Dash in 2020, after playing it multiple times with a fellow YouTuber friends "Vortrox" and "PollyMars".
Other ventures
Music
In 2022, Rapier released a song called "Jazzy Juice", which later uploaded after he hit one million subscribers on YouTube as a special event.
Personal life
Samuel Rapier was born on January 26, 2006 in Liberty Hill, Texas, raised by his mother. He was currently experience his father which by the younger age.
Health issues
On April 2025, Rapier revealed that he had health issues, included that he was sitting in the toilet seat and allegedly his head was bump against the wall, which later had a mark on his forehead. Shortly after, he vomited multiple times, after stated that he was sick.
